senses.gloss: (b. h.; √גא, גו , גה to rise; to be arched, caved) to rise, swell; trnsf. to be elated, proud; to be exalted, majestic. Mekh. B’shall., Shirah 2, v. infra. [Tosef. M. Kat. I, 7 גּוֹאֶה, v. גָּהָה.]

to exalt. Mekh. l. c. גֵּאַנִּי וגֵאתִיו He (the Lord) exalted me, and I exalt him; Tanḥ. ib. 12 גֵּאַוְנִי וגֵאִיתִיו; Yalk. Ex. 242 וגואותיו (corr. acc.). Y. Taan. III, 67ᵃ top (ref. to Job XXIII, 29) אני אמרתי להשפילן … לגָאוֹתָן I (the Lord) decreed to humble them (by dearth), and thou—to raise them (Bab. ib. 23ᵃ הגבהתו).

, Nithpa. נִתְגָּאֶה to show one’s self glorious, exalt one’s self, be exalted; (in an evil sense) to be proud, boast, to lord it. Mekh. l. c. (ref. to Ex. XV, 1) גָּאָה ועתיד להִתְגָּאוֹת He was glorious and will be &c.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 15:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מִתְגָּאֶה הוא על כל המִתְגָּאִים</he> He exalts himself above all those who are boastful, <he>שֶׁבַּמֶּה שאו״ה מתג׳ לפניו וכ׳</he> for that with which the nations boast themselves, becomes the means of their punishment; Tanḥ. l. c.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 5b:15">Ib. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>פרנס המתג׳ וכ׳</he> an officer who lords it over the community.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 98a:8">B. Bath. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>המתג׳ בטלית וכ׳</he> who parades the scholar’s cloak.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:10">Tosef. Sot. III, 10</cite> sq. <he>לא נִתְגָּאוּ אלא וכ׳</he> became haughty only in consequence of the bounties &c.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 109a">Snh. 109ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 10b">Ber. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>לאחר שאכל ושתה ונתג׳ זה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לאחר שנתג׳</he>; Yalk. Kings … <he>זה ונתג׳</he>; Lev. 616 <he>לאחר שגאה</he>) after this man has eaten and drunk and become haughty, v. <cite ref="C00020"><he>גֵּאִים</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <he>נתג׳ לבו עליו</he> (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37">Ex. R. s. 37</cite> <he>זחה דעתו</he>) became overbearing.
